_note: Diagnostic, not a result: no number reported in the paper rests on this file. The assistant running the experiments selected a small free-text 8B model as the H3 judge at execution time, the approved plan having specified judge(question, answer, model) without naming one, and then on its own initiative had a second model from another family (Claude) re-label the same outputs as a cross-check. Agreement was 16/31 on the base arm. On review that whole line of work was rejected: the 8B judge was retired on 2026-07-27 and all of H1 (95 prompts) and H3 (186 answers) were relabelled with the logit_bias-forced Qwen2.5-72B judge (exp/relabel_structured_2026-07-27.py, runs/relabel_2026-07-27/), which is the only judge the paper describes and the only one any reported statistic comes from. This file is kept for completeness, so that a discarded labelling attempt is not silently absent from the record, and not because anything depends on it.
